Avery Brooks: Heads-up 4: TokenSaver cache + accounting change is ready for staging. This modifies token charge timing (post-token vs pre-token) and introduces a shared prefix cache. We need a safe rollout plan across hosted api with minimal billing surprises.

Noor Khan: Major risks: customers seeing one-off bill spikes, cache anti-affinity causing latency regressions for small tenants. Suggest feature-flagged rollout with billing shadow and read-only shadow cache first.

Diego Alvarez: Can we do an A/B where B gets cached accounting but doesn't change billing totals (shadow-billing)? We'll need mismatch detection and a rollback plan.

Mei Lin: Telemetry gates:
- delta_monthly_cost_per_tenant > 10% for 1% of revenue-weighted tenants -> pause
- p95 generation latency increase > 80ms over baseline for 15m -> rollback
- cache hit rate < 30% for cohort -> hold and investigate

Avery Brooks: Good. Sequence idea:
1) internal-only opt-in (engineering org) + shadow-billing 24h
2) 1% traffic cohort (random) with shadow-billing + read-only cache 48h
3) 5% cohort with real cache reads but billed as legacy (no charge delta) 72h
4) 20% cohort with billed-as-new accounting + customer comms 72h
5) 100% rollout after green checks

Noor Khan: Add enterprise opt-in path for customers who want early cost savings. Opt-in should show estimated monthly delta in console and require explicit acceptance. Also need a rate limiter per-tenant to avoid cache storm hits.

Diego Alvarez: Ops automation: kill-switch command `rbac action:feature-toggle --name tokenSaver --set legacy` and traffic-drain window 30s. Also a fast path to convert shadow-billing to real if opt-in accepted.

Mei Lin: A/B metrics list: bill_delta_pct, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_rate, cache_hit_rate, revenue_exposed_tenants. Use both rolling windows and lookback comparisons. Set enrichment for top-10 revenue tenants.

Avery Brooks: Sampling math note: for baseline 200k req/day, 1% ~2k req/day. For billing delta detection we need revenue-weighted sampling. Noor, can you run numbers on how many revenue-weighted tenants to include to get 90% power to detect 7% cost change?

Noor Khan: On it. Quick note: 1% random may miss top revenue tenants. We'll do stratified sampling: 50% random, 50% revenue-tail selects.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: token-saver/staging/dryrun at 1768881800. Health checks: 200 OK, p95 < 300ms.

Diego Alvarez: Customer comms: include example bill preview, how-to opt-out, and contact support link. Lina from CS had a template we can reuse.

Mei Lin: Add post-deploy evaluation: run mismatch detector daily for first 7 days, auto-open incident if any tenant mismatch > $50 or >10% deviation for >3 consecutive hours.

Avery Brooks: Roles: Noor = rollout sampling & billing guardrails, Diego = rollback automation & ops runbook, Mei = telemetry gates & evals, Avery = launch sign-off + customer comm coordination.

Noor Khan: Next steps: update feature flag phases to include staging/shadow steps and publish runbook (ETA EOD).

Diego Alvarez: I'll test kill-switch and billing shadow toggles in staging (ETA tomorrow).

Mei Lin: I'll wire the telemetry alerts and mismatch detector (ETA tomorrow afternoon).

Avery Brooks: Thanks team. We'll meet during product standup tomorrow for final go/no-go. Ping me @oncall if urgent. :rocket:
